X99-DS4 Intel LGA 2011-V3 Full ATX Server Motherboard in Bangladesh


The X99-DS4 Intel LGA 2011-V3 Full ATX Server Motherboard is a high-performance and cost-effective solution for enterprise servers and professional workstations. Designed to support Intel Xeon E5-2600 V3/V4 series processors, this motherboard delivers excellent stability, scalability, and 24/7 reliability for business-critical environments.


Powered by the Intel B85 chipset, the X99-DS4 ensures efficient system performance and dependable operation. It supports DDR4 ECC and non-ECC memory, helping maintain data accuracy and system stability in server and virtualization workloads.


With multiple PCIe expansion slots, the X99-DS4 allows easy expansion for RAID controllers, GPUs, high-speed network cards, and storage adapters. Its Full ATX form factor makes it suitable for both rackmount and tower server chassis.


At OTECH BD, we provide genuine X99-DS4 server motherboards in Bangladesh, ideal for businesses looking for reliable server hardware at a competitive price.


Key Features


  • Brand: Angxun
  • Chipest：Intel B85 Chipset
  • Supports LGA 2011-3 Intel series processors
  • Supports quad-channel DDR4 DIMM memoryslots
  • 6 x SATA sockets
  • 2 x M.2 slots (supports NVMe mode only)
  • Rear I/O provides 6 x USB 2.0; 2 x USB 3.0
  • Onboard headers for 2 x USB 2.0; 2 x USB 3.0expansion
  • 1 x Gigabit Ethernet port, supports PXE andWake -on-LAN
  • 2 x PCIe x1 slots
  • 2 x PCIe x16 slots
  • 1 x PS/2 interface; 1 x onboard COM header
  • Supports 24-pin + 8-pin ATX power input
  • Compatible with Windows 7, Windows 10, andLinux
